sloka: इति संचिन्तयित्वा तु निःश्वस्य च पुनः पुनः ।जगाम वेगेन तदा वसिष्ठम् परम ओजसम् ॥१-५४-५॥
transliteration: iti saṁcintayitvā tu niḥśvasya ca punaḥ punaḥ ।jagāma vegena tadā vasiṣṭham parama ojasam ॥1-54-5॥

translations.english: "O Destroyer of enemies thus thinking and repeatedly sighing, that cow shook off those attendants who were in hundreds and ran towards the feet of the illustrious Vasishta with the speed of the wind.
translations.hindi: NA क्या मेरी माता ने सब प्राणियों के पूज्य श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का फलमूलादि वन्य पदार्थो से सत्कार किया था ?
